pillars.name: KME-L challenger (index-first access plan)
pillars.rule: IC-gen2 P closes IMPLEMENTED_AND_VERIFIED only when: (1) the kme_pillars access plan is certified index -> project-scoped raw -> global raw only on an explicit cross-project question, a guard failure deopts with a logged reason, and invalidation is keyed on source watermark, parser version, attribution version and metric definition; (2) the 7 KME-L measurement files (D, E, F, G, H, I, L) reproduce identically from the challenger; (3) a champion vs scoped vs challenger table (wall, raw bytes, unique bytes, raw files opened, cross-project bytes exposed) is measured against frozen champion run5 and run6; (4) a KME-only query opens zero CostaLuz bytes and a negative control proves that check can fail; (5) changing a source or the parser version invalidates exactly the affected closure; (6) the certified path is promoted through modules/tower/ratchet.promote at project scope, a fresh worker asked a KME question without naming the index takes the index path (the path log shows the hit), and bypassing the index turns a gate red. Allowed loss (D-OQ4): if the challenger does not beat the scoped path on repeated queries, P closes FALSIFIED_OR_REJECTED_BY_EVIDENCE with a falsification artifact naming [P] (IC-gen2) that carries the table; that is a valid pre-registered outcome, not a failure. A narrowed challenger closes IMPLEMENTED_AND_VERIFIED only for the narrowed scope named in its reason and evidence.

pillars.name: generic opportunity detectors + discovery eval
pillars.rule: IC-gen2 Q closes IMPLEMENTED_AND_VERIFIED only when: (1) detectors extend CO-12 (modules/cognitive_os/co_12_telemetry.py record_signal) with no new top-level component and cover read amplification (same path + content read N times), scan amplification (bytes read / evidence consumed), a repeated identical command with unchanged inputs, a retry without causal delta, and a model call answering a deterministic question; (2) counters are cheap and always on, with detail only on anomaly; (3) the discovery eval finds the KME-L hotspot without any KME-specific signature, finds one seeded hotspot, does not flag one known no-optimization case, rejects one low-ROI case, and reports detected / missed / false positive counts; (4) detector overhead is measured. Any other ending needs a falsification artifact naming [Q] (IC-gen2).
